verdict.rationale: Navan's pricing page mentions it can 'manage expenses and issue reimbursements' and supports receipt scanning for expense capture, implying an out-of-pocket expense workflow exists, but there is no evidence describing direct deposit specifics, reimbursement speed ('days'), or a submission-to-payout tracking view. missing for 10: direct deposit payout mechanism, reimbursement timeline/SLA details, status-tracking UI from submission to payout.
